text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The self-proclaimed "Friendship" members of the homecoming club returned to the schoolyard to enthusiastically participate in the sports events.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかよし部を自称する帰宅部一同は、
ふたたび校庭に戻って運動競技に精を出していた。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Chargee!
text_block_list.orig_text: でりゃああああ！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Chierrun☆
text_block_list.orig_text: ちぇっるぅーーーん☆

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Doooryaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: どおぉぉぉりゃああああぁぁあああ！

text_block_list.name: チエル
text_block_list.text:
ちぇるん☆　
ちぇる～ん☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぇるん☆　
ちぇる～ん☆

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Phew... We've been running so much... From short sprints to middle-distance races to obstacle courses... Well, with this many first-place wins, we should be safe for now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぁー……
走った走ったァー……
短距離走に中距離走に障害物走……
ま、
こんだけ１位カッ攫っときゃ、
とりま安泰でしょ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: In terms of individual events, we've done all we can, haven't we? Now we just have to trust our teammates and do our best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
個人競技に関しては、
もうやれるだけやったってカンジですよね。
あとはチームメイトを信じて、
なむー

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Refined team: 352, Pure team: 357.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しとやか352、
きよらか357。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the competition is in the middle stages. We've crossed the halfway point, and although the enemy's tail is practically in our grasp, to put it succinctly, it's a close match.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふ、
勝負は中盤戦──
折り返し点を越えた辺りだが、
すでに敵の尾は掴んだも同然、
端的に言って僅差だ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Let us be proud, comrades. This good news is the result of the sweat we've shed. Phew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誇ろう、
戦友たち。
この吉報は、
我々の流した汗が生んだものだ。
ふぅ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is Yuni-Senpai wiping her sweat so contentedly? While we were desperately sweating and running around, she was just lazily spreading a seat on the spectator's side and lying down, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なんでユニ先輩が清々しく汗ぬぐってるんです？
うちらが必死に汗水流して走り回ってる間、
観覧席にシート広げてだらしなく寝っ転がってただけじゃないすか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: That's right, she was just lazily lying down and scratching her butt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーすよ、
だらしなく寝っ転がって尻掻いてただけじゃないすか。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: What's with that? Before being a lady, I'm a human. Scratching one's butt is a common physiological action for any living being. Are you criticizing such a normal behavior?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだね。
ぼくとて淑女である前に人間だ、
尻ぐらい掻くこともある。
生物としてごく当たり前の生理行動を咎めるというのか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you telling me you were actually scratching your butt when you casually mentioned it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
テキトー言っただけなのに、
リアルに掻いてたんすか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: No, well, it's not about blaming you for scratching your butt. It's more about how you were slacking off and lounging around instead of participating in the competition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
てゆか、
尻掻いてたのが悪いッつってんじゃなくて、
競技サボってゴロゴロしてたのが悪いって話なんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, you should have said that from the beginning. Why did you single out my butt in particular? Do you really dislike my butt that much?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったら最初からそう言えばいいだろう。
なぜ殊更にぼくの尻をあげつらった。
貴様そんなにぼくの尻が憎いのか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: No, not really.
text_block_list.orig_text: いやべつに。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: So, do you actually find my butt endearing...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
では、
僕の尻を愛しいと思っているのか……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Either way is fine. But honestly, I've never attached any specific feelings to someone else's butt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どっちでもねーわ。
そもそも他人の尻に特定の感情抱いたことがねーわ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Um... Could you both stop dragging this tasteless conversation on? Can't we talk about something cuter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのう……
お二人とも、
その品のない話いつまで引っ張るんです？
もっときゃわわな話にしません？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: What? Are you telling me not to scratch my butt in front of you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだと？　
君までぼくに尻を掻くなと言うのか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: No, I mean, you're the only one going on about scratching the butt. And please stop making it sound like I'm a perpetrator of butt harassment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、尻トーク無限に続けてンの、
ユニ先輩だけなんだけど。
うちまで尻ハラ加害者みたいに言うのやめてくんない。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it! It's about time you stopped discussing that kind of unrefined topic in front of Chieru!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからそれですよ！
チエルの前でそういうかわいくない単語を
連呼しないでくださいって言ってるんです！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that? It sounds kind of sketchy. You are 16, and have never used "butt" word once?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
何それ、
カマトトきっつ。
あんた16年生きてきて尻って単語一度も使ったことないわけ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Chieru properly adds an "ock" to it! If you add an "ock," it sounds cute and endearing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
チエルはちゃんと頭に「お」を付けますー！
「お」を付ければぷりっとかわいい語感になるんですー！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Add an "ock," huh... I see, buttock. When you say buttock, can I scratch my buttock?
text_block_list.orig_text:
「お」を付ける……
なるほど、
おケツか。
おケツと言えば
ぼくはおケツを掻いてもいいんだな？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: If it's a buttock, then go ahead, Chieru.
text_block_list.orig_text: おケツならいんだろーチエル。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Hold on a moment! Can't we keep the uncouth jokes to yourselves? I'm not exactly comfortable discussing lewd topics, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！
品のないノリはそちらだけで処理してもらえません！？
チエルこう見えて
意外とシモい話得意じゃないんですけど！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Don't spout platitudes. Whether a king, saint, or great sage, if their skin itches, they scratch it. You're probably no different at home, gingerly scratching your behind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
綺麗事をぬかすんじゃあないよ。
王者も聖者も大賢者も、
皮膚に痒み走らば掻かぬ者はおらん。
君とてどうせ家では
ごわしごわしと尻を掻き散らかしているのだろう。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: I don't make those noises! Chieru's peachy and cute peachy behind makes a pink sound!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな音しませんー！
チエルのぷりぷりキュートな桃尻は
ピンクの音色を奏でるんですー！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Peachy butt (lol). You're hilarious. Are you writing a romance novel or something? So cheesy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
桃尻（笑）
ウケる。
官能小説かよ。
きめえ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hey, Chloe, add an "ock" too. You might get scolded by the cute-and-bouncy-peachy-police.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおいクロエ君、
「お」を付けたまえ。
ぷりぷりキュートな桃尻警察に怒られてしまうよ？

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Roarrr! Noooo! Butt talk, butt talk, you're so annoying! It's fine to talk about butts! I'll make Chieru shove Chieru into Chieru's hole and make Chieru's teeth say Chieru Chieru!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だあああァー！　
もおおおーっ！
ケツケツ、ケツケツ、うっせえわ！　
いいんですよケツの話は！
ちぇるの穴からちぇる突っ込んでちぇる歯ちぇるちぇる言わせますよ！

text_block_list.name: Yuni & Chloe
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんなさい。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Um... Sorry for interrupting your discussion about buttocks, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのう……
臀部談義で盛り上がり中のところすみませんが……

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Chieeeru~♪ I'm Chieeeru, the dreaming cute girl☆ Today, I've come from a fairytale land on a rainbow rail with a pumpkin carriage. Kyaa! Elegantly refined sisters of the sophisticated group, what's happening with you all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぇる～ん♪　
夢見る美少女ちえるんでっす☆
今日はおとぎの国から虹のレールをかぼちゃの馬車でやってきました。
キャッ！　
しとやか仲間のお姉さま方、
どうかされたんですかぁ～？

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, it's just that Chloe has something to talk about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いえその、
少々
クロエさんにお話が……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Hey, what happened to you? Looks like you're limping.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
何どしたん。
足引きずってるみたいだけど。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Actually... In the track race earlier, I tripped and ended up spraining it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが
実は……
先ほどの徒競走で、
転んだ拍子に挫いてしまって……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Seriously? Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジ？
え、
だいじょぶなん。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Yes, as long as I'm walking slowly, it's fine, but... the school nurse has advised me against vigorous exercise...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
このように、
多少歩く分には問題ないのですが……
養護の先生からは、
激しい運動を禁じられてしまいまして……

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: But she's still scheduled to perform later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが彼女は、
この後にもご自身の出番を控えているのです。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. Alright, then, should I take your place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうなんだ。
いいよ、
したら、
うち代わろうか？

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Well! Is that okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ！　
よろしいのですか！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Uh, it's not really...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
べつに全然それは。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: So, is it okay? Are you sure it's okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろしいのですね？
本当によろしいのですね？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: I said it's fine. Why are you being so thorough? Yeah, sure, let's go. Which course?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だァーら、
いいつってンじゃん。
なんでそんな念入りなの。
いいよ、
行くよ、
コースどこ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: This way.
text_block_list.orig_text: こちらですわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: Excellent.
text_block_list.orig_text: しめしめですわ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: ...Chieru-kun, what do you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……チエル君、
どうだろうか。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: There seems to be something behind this. It sounds interesting, so let's go along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか裏がありそうですね。
面白そうなんで付いて行ってみましょう。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's this, hey?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい。
なんだこれおい。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa, Miss Chloe, you look fabulous!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃああああ
素敵ですわクロエさん！

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: You look really great, Miss Chloe!
text_block_list.orig_text: とてもお似合いですわクロエさん！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: So so cute and dangerously charming, Miss Chloe! She's a pure and adorable angel, completely unrelated to butt talk, Miss Chloeee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すこすこヤバヤバのめちゃかわボンバーですわクロエさん！
尻トークとは一生無縁のぴゅあぴゅあ天使ですわクロエさーん！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Shut up. Your face and actions are all annoying.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるさい。
顔も動きもすべてがうるさい。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Chloe-kun... You're quite something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クロエ君……
大概だぞ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Answer the question. Hey, what's this, hey?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいから質問に答えれ。
おい。
なんだこれおい。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: It's a mock store in the form of a maid café presented by the Pure team.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「しとやか」組が出展している、
模擬店形式のメイド喫茶ですわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: And these are the maid uniforms for serving the customers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして
お客様に給仕するための
メイド服ですわ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: The maids greet the customers by tilting their heads slightly and saying, "Welcome home, Master☆."
text_block_list.orig_text:
メイドのご挨拶は、
首をちょこんと横へ傾けて
「お帰り
なさいませ
ご主人様☆」
ですわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: I'll roll you bastards into the depths of hell, so don't ever come back, you damn idiots.
text_block_list.orig_text:
冥途の果てまでブチ転がしてやるから
二度と帰ってくんじゃねえぞクソ共。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa! There it is, Miss Chloe's foul-mouthed abuse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃああああ！　
出ましたわ、
クロエさんのド汚い罵詈雑言ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: As expected of the delinquent Miss Chloe, even your angry appearance is appreciated!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすが不良のクロエさん、
お怒りになられる姿も
ありがたみですわ！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: A hybrid of cute and cool, the tsundere maid café is now open!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キュートとクールのハイブリッド、
ツンデレメイド喫茶開幕ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where's the dere part? I can't see any dere in my eyes. Right now, my killer's eyes are in full "I'm-gonna-kill-you" mode.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
どこにデレがあんの。
うちのこの目がデレてる目に見えんの。
今こそ殺し屋の目ぇ全開バッキバキなんですケド。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Miss Chloe, I'm sorry it ended up like this, kind of deceiving. But if you can't take over, the victory for the "Refined" team will...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クロエさん、
騙すような形になってしまい
申し訳ありません。
ですが、
もし引き受けていただけませんと
「しとやか」の勝利は……

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: Actually, we just visited the Pure team's mock stores, and all of them were of uniformly high quality. If there's a vacancy here, it could become a fatal reason for our defeat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は私たち、
先ほど
「きよらか」の模擬店を回ってきたのですが、
いずれも皆一様に
高水準でレベルが高いのです。
こちらの店舗に欠員が出ては、
致命的な敗因になりかねませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: This is bad, Chloe-kun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに、
それはまずいぞクロエ君。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: This is really not good, Chloe-senpai.
text_block_list.orig_text: まずいですよクロエ先輩。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: I don't care.
text_block_list.orig_text: 知らんがな。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on, isn't this conversation off track? I thought I was going to switch in for the sports events.
text_block_list.orig_text:
てゆか待って、
そもそも話ちがくない？
うち運動競技だと思って代わるッつったんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Sports events? No, we haven't mentioned that word at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
運動競技？
いいえ、
私たち
そのような単語は一言も発しておりませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: And we confirmed multiple times if you were okay with it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
「よろしいのですね」と
何度も確認いたしましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Seriously. That sloppy chatting from earlier, there was actually some crafty mental battle going on behind the scenes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジで。
さっきの雑なカラミ、
裏でそんな頓智の利いた頭脳戦が繰り広げられてたの。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Well, well, Chloe-senpai. Just think of it as being deceived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ、
いいじゃないですかクロエ先輩。
ここは一つ、
騙されたと思って。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Already been deceived. That idiom, you're not using it right. It's like saying "thinking you got bit by a stray dog."
text_block_list.orig_text:
すでに騙されてンだよ。
その慣用句、使い方そーじゃないでしょ。
「野良犬に噛まれたと思って」みたいに言うなし。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: But Chloe-kun is actually experienced in customer service and the food industry. I think she's the most suitable among us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしクロエ君は事実、
接客業も飲食業も慣れている。
我々の中でもっとも適任だと思うのだが。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that's true, but... well, actually, working is not the issue, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはまあ、
そーなんだろうけど……
いや、てか、
ぶっちゃけ働くの自体はべつにいんだけどー

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Not "but," it's just that, what's with these clothes? Frills and puff sleeves, they're not my style at all. It's embarrassing... Oh well, I can't do this, I'll go change.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いんだけど、
じゃなくて、
何なんこの服。
フリルとかパフスリーブとか、
うちのキャラじゃないじゃん。
恥っず……
あーも、
やっぱ無理だわ、
着替えてくる。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Why, why?! This kind of Chloe-senpai is totally fine too! See, look, {0}-senpai also thinks so, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ～ッ！？
なんでなんで！　
こういうクロエ先輩も全然アリですって！
ね、
ほら、
{0}先輩もそう思うでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Not a chance. There's no way someone like me, with killer eyes, would look good in something like this. It's a lie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ないわ。
殺し屋の目ぇした女にこんなんハマるわけないし、
嘘じゃん。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: But this senpai can't really tell lies or flatter people with clever words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
でもこの先輩、
嘘とかお世辞とか気の利いたこと言えるようなタマじゃないですよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that so? Wait, then what about it? Are you seriously saying it looks good on me? Creepy. But, well... hmm. So that's it. Creepy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
そうだっけ？
え、じゃ何、
あんた本気で似合うとか言っちゃってんの。
きも。
てゆか……
ふーん。
そうなんだ。
きも。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's a shame, but it can't be helped. If Chloe-kun dislikes it to that extent, we can't force her. Alright then, in that case, I'll help out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううむ、
残念だが仕方ないな。
クロエ君がそこまで嫌がるなら
無理強いはできまい。
よし、
というわけで、
ここはぼくが一肌脱ごう。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Yuni-senpai's size is probably a no-go. The experienced ones on the floor would be more helpful. It's fine, I'll do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユニ先輩のサイズ、
多分ないでしょ。
フロア回すの、
経験者の方がアドいし。
いいよ、
うちがやるよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Is that okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！　
よろしいのですか！

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: Are you really taking it on?
text_block_list.orig_text: 引き受けてくださるのですか！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Is the tsundere maid café finally making its grand appearance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツンデレメイド喫茶
ついに爆誕ですか！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: What's up with these guys? They set up this whole situation where it's certain we'd have to back out, and now they're acting surprised...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだこいつら。
バックレたら鬼確定な流れ作っといて何を今更……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Well, can't be helped. You, your injury is legit, right? Okay, I'll cover the gaps in the schedule.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、しゃーないじゃん。
あんた、怪我したってのはガチなんでしょ？
おけ、
シフトに穴空いちゃった分ぐらいは埋めとくよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Miss Chloe... Thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クロエさん……
ありがとうございますわ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: I'm falling in love with you all over again...
text_block_list.orig_text: 一生惚れ直しですわ……

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Next year will be the tsundere cat-eared café...
text_block_list.orig_text:
来年は
ツンデレ猫耳喫茶ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Right this way, please take a seat in one of the open spots.
text_block_list.orig_text:
らっしゃーせー
空きめの席にどうぞ座っときー

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you're really used to this, aren't you? As expected of Chloe-kun who made a name for herself in paid volunteering.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
やはり慣れたものだな。
流石は有償ボランティアで鳴らしたクロエ君だ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: By the way, you guys were saying earlier that all the mock stores from "Pure" Team are of high quality.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで君たち、
先ほど「きよらか」の模擬店は
みなレベルが高いと言っていたな。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. We've been hearing nothing but good reviews, so we got curious and visited several food-related shops...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
そうなんです。
良い評判ばかり耳にしますので、
私たちも気になって、
飲食系のお店を幾つか回ってみたのですけれど──

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: All of them were surprisingly delicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれもとても美味しくて
びっくりしてしまいましたの。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
左様か、
ふむ……

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: So, here we are, the star of our school, competing against them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですから。
こちらは我が校一の看板娘で対抗なのですわ。

text_block_list.name: Passing Schoolgirl
text_block_list.text: Well, take a look! Could it be, that person wearing that cute server outfit and having eyes like an assassin...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
ご覧になって！
もしや、
あのかわいらしい給仕服をお召しになっている、
殺し屋のような目をしたお方は……！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's this? Suddenly, the students seem to be gathering...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？
はて、
にわかに生徒たちが集まってきたようだが……

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: What's going on? They're swarming. Not just the "Refined" team's kids, even the enemy team's kids are here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんですかね、
わらわらと。
「しとやか」の子たちだけじゃなくて、
敵の子たちまでいますよ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: Hehe, just as I thought. Actually, there are quite a few hidden fans of Miss Chloe in this academy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
思った通りですわ。
実はこの学院、
クロエさんの隠れファンが少なくないのです。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: It's a bit intimidating to approach the delinquents, so everyone's been keeping their admiration a secret.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不良の方にお声掛けするなんて畏れ多くて、
皆さん隠れっぱなしのままなのですけれどね。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Certainly, with Chieru on the outside and Chloe on the inside, they say they've split the popularity within the school.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに表のチエル裏のクロエで、
学内の人気を二分しているって言いますもんね。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 1
text_block_list.text: That's news to me.
text_block_list.orig_text: それは初耳ですけれど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: And Yuni-senpai's followers, although not numerous in number, are said to overpower others in their enthusiasm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてユニ博士の信奉者は、
数こそ多くないものの
熱量では他を圧倒すると言うな。

text_block_list.name: Chloe's Classmate 2
text_block_list.text: That's unexpected news to me.
text_block_list.orig_text: それは寝耳に水ですけれど。

text_block_list.name: Student's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh? There's a café over there, and many people are lined up. They must be offering some incredibly delicious menu items.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
あちらのカフェ、
大勢の方が並んでいらっしゃいますわ。
きっと
余程の美味しいメニューをいただけますのね。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Ohh!? While we were talking about that, even customers from other places have been drawn to see what's happening!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおー！？
そんなこと言ってる間に、
よそから来たお客さんたちまで何事かと吸い寄せられてますよ！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: It's the viral effect. Alright, this is our chance. Let's support them. Let's cheer them on, saying how amazing this place is, in front of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
行列効果というやつか。
よし好機だ、
我々は援護するぞ。
彼ら彼女らの前で、
すげーやべーこの店さいこー
と囃したてるのだ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: The so-called Sakura. Sounds good, let's do it! We will make it viral, the Cherry Blossom of Chieru!
text_block_list.orig_text:
通称サクラ。
いいですね、
やりましょう！
咲かせてみせます、
ちぇる桜！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we won again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふ、
また勝ってしまったな。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the successful strategy of using Miss Chloe, who gained fame through her injury, the "Refined" team achieved great success in the mock store competition...
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪我の功名が功を奏した看板娘大作戦により、
盛況を博した「しとやか」組は模擬店勝負をものにした──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...or so it seemed. There was a shadow cast by the student council monitoring it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──かに見えたが。
それを監視している生徒会の陰があった。

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 1
text_block_list.text: Kuh... You guys, who call yourselves Friendship Club, are just a bunch of go-home club members!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
おのれですわ、
なかよし部を名乗るただの帰宅部！

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 2
text_block_list.text: A tsundere maid café, what a secret plan you had...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツンデレメイド喫茶、
あのような秘策があったとは
ですわ……！

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: They're desperately resisting as well. To think that the infamous delinquent girl would expose herself in such a way in public. Heh, suits you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちらもなりふり構わず必死に抵抗するものです。
悪名高き非行少女が、
よもやあのような媚態を公衆に晒すとは。
ふっ、
お似合いですこと。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: Secretary Natalie, it might be a good idea to secretly transcribe this with transcription magic. That appearance might become her Achilles' heel someday.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナタリー書記、
ひそかに転写魔法で記録しておくと良いでしょう。
あの姿はいずれ
誇り高き彼女のアキレス腱となるかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 1
text_block_list.text: I see, it could be used as a means of blackmail if the need arises.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
いざというとき
脅迫手段として使えるということですわね。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: Choose your words carefully. For the sake of justice, the master approves of any means necessary.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言葉は選んでください。
正義のためには、
主もあらゆる手段をお認めになるだけのこと。

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 1
text_block_list.text: M-My apologize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
失礼いたしました。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: How are our mock stores doing?
text_block_list.orig_text: 我が方の模擬店はどうなっていますか。

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 2
text_block_list.text: Of course, all the shops are steadily attracting customers. It's about time the reputation starts bringing in a lot of points.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論、
いずれの店舗も順調に客足を伸ばしております。
そろそろ評判が評判を呼んで、
大量の得点が入ってくる頃合でしょう。

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member 1
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we have an array of renowned shops here. Even if only one shop from "Refined" has thrived, it's still just a drop in the bucket.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
こちらは名店揃いですものね。
「しとやか」のたかだか一店舗が賑わったところで、
所詮は焼け石に水ですわ。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: Of course. Otherwise, there's no point in arranging things everywhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論です。
そうでなくては方々に手配した意味がありません。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: Too bad for you, second-year Chloe. Even your lowly secret plans that threw away the pride of a delinquent are utterly powerless before justice. As you, who once stood as a revolutionary high and mighty, have now lost your fangs, I can only feel pity for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念でしたね、
クロエ二年生。
不良の矜持まで捨てた卑しい秘策も、
正義の前にはひたすら無力。
群れを成して牙の抜けたあなたには、
もはや憐憫すら覚えます。

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: This is my way of repaying you as a former classmate. For you, who were once a noble revolutionary, I will bring an end...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは元同級生たる私なりの恩情、
介錯です。
かつて孤高の革命家であった気高きあなたのためにも──

text_block_list.name: Maria
text_block_list.text: ...to the Friendship Club.
text_block_list.orig_text:
滅してさしあげましょう、
なか……
帰宅部を。
